svg.title: Connected straight, left arc, right arc and straight
svg.desc: Two 1 m straights joined by a 30 degree left arc and a 30 degree right arc, each with radius 2 m. The free entry is orange and the free exit blue. Three connected port pairs are marked by green circles, tangential arrows and dashed perpendicular boundary lines extending 10 cm beyond the dark road edges. Both straight sections are horizontal.
